summary: Per-frame pit stop progress tick on the pit machine: while session_time is below the pit completion threshold (this+0x1A4), applies timed wheel-force ramps for repair phases and ramps the pit speed limiter; once the threshold is passed, deactivates the speed limiter, clears the AI reason code, notifies the pit state machine of exit, computes pit-stop elapsed time, dispatches post-pit cleanup and AI commands for the player vehicle, resets wheel forces and camera mode, and triggers pit-crew element actions plus audio.

operations.description: Session time below the pit completion threshold (this+0x1A4) selects the active servicing path; the else branch runs the pit-exit sequence.
Pit-mid flag (this+0x1AC) is set and session time is inside the last 2.0 seconds before completion (this+0x1A4 - 2.0 <= session_time).
Clear the pit-mid flag at this+0x1AC to 0 once the mid-pit event fires.
Run a short computation (ShortComputation_d410) on the session manager dword_5EA510.
Speed limiter engaged (this+0x1C0 non-zero) and session time beyond the phase-one timestamp this+0x1B4.
Compute limiter speed as (session_time - this+0x1B4) * 12.0 + this+0x1B0, clamped to the ceiling this+0x1B8.
Apply the computed limiter speed via SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror.
Wheel-force parameter block present (this+0x1C4 non-zero) gates the repair force ramps.
Session time within the wheel-force window (session_time <= this+0x1D4).
Ramp front and rear wheel-force parameters from window base this+0x1D0 with 0.16 slope within 0.2/1.4 second sub-windows and 0.096000001 caps.
Apply wheel-force parameters (front, front, rear, rear) via WheelForceParameterSet.
When session time exceeds the window end this+0x1D4, zero all wheel-force parameters.
Else branch: speed limiter engaged (this+0x1C0 non-zero) triggers limiter deactivation.
Write final limiter speed this+0x1B8 through SpeedValueSetterWithGlobalMirror.
AI enable flag (obj+0x32C8) set, limiter speed positive, and AI reason code obj+0x4068 equal to 9, so the stale reason code must be cleared.
Clear the AI reason code obj+0x4068 to 0 when the limiter deactivates with the code still at 9.
Notify the pit state machine of state 4 via StateChangeNotify to leave the pit stop.
Compute pit stop elapsed (this+0x1A8) as current reference time dbl_8AFEA0 minus pit entry time this+0x1A0.
Current player vehicle (dword_7C54F0 indexed by dword_7C54DC, +18580) matches this vehicle index this+0x4 and finish state obj+0x4064 is not 1, allowing pit-exit audio.
Dispatch pit-exit audio event sub_4D8760(6, 0).
AI enable flag obj+0x32C8 set to 1 gates post-pit AI cleanup.
Run PostPitCleanup on the base vehicle (this+0x0 deref).
Dispatch AI command message 15 with argument 0 via AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher on the base vehicle.
Zero all wheel-force parameters via WheelForceParameterSet after pit exit.
Reset the camera mode to 0 via CameraModeSetter on pit exit.
Pit crew object present at this+0x8 gates per-element action dispatch.
Dispatch conditional action 0 to the pit crew object via PerElementConditionalActionDispatcher.
Global counter dword_7CF884 positive and vehicle pit-crew-mesh flag obj+0x105C not already 1, so the mesh load should be triggered.
Set the pit-crew-mesh flag obj+0x105C to 1 to trigger crew mesh loading.
Vehicle detail-level value obj+0x1054 read as a sound-effect dispatch parameter; the audio routine invoked is absent from the packet callee evidence.
Return the accumulated status byte.
